updates.sourceText: 1 Diffuser Performance - Local Load Trailing edge detail changes on diffuser winglet cascade Modifications made to the trailing edge lead to an increase in the local aerodynamic load acting on the winglet cascade, consequently increasing the overall aerodynamic load at the rear of the car. 2 Mirror Stay Structural Improvement Small leading edge surface changes Aerodynamic surface geometry has been revised in order to accommodate and integrate the latest structural improvements made to the component.
